description:
You are an order fulfillment specialist setting up a WooCommerce store for US sales and processing the first order.

1. Enable taxes: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > General and check 'Enable tax rates and calculations'. Save changes.
2. Configure a tax rate: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Standard rates. Add a tax rate for US state California (CA) with rate 8.25%, tax name 'CA Sales Tax', and priority 1. Apply to all zip codes and cities (leave those fields blank).
3. Create a shipping zone: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping. Add a shipping zone named 'California' that covers the US state California. Add a 'Flat rate' shipping method to this zone with cost $7.99.
4. Create a new manual order: Go to WooCommerce > Orders > Add Order. Add these existing products as line items:
   - Organic Cotton T-Shirt x2
   - Bamboo Cutting Board Set x1
   Set the customer to the existing customer 'Jane Smith' (jane.smith@example.com). Set the billing state to 'CA'. Add an order note (private note): 'Priority fulfillment - customer loyalty reward'. Set the order status to 'Processing' and save the order.
